body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a Node.js script and corresponding test suite to build a bounded, candidate-only input packet shard (shard-000) for visual-required 9709 rows, along with related markdown and validation artifacts. The review feedback suggests several robustness improvements: explicitly validating that entries in `sanitizeCandidateVlmOutputRows` are non-null objects, validating the shape of the loaded `rightsOverlay` input file, and adding a fail-closed unit test case to verify behavior when the visual inventory input is malformed.
